ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "X-CORRELATION-ID": attributes.headers.'x-correlation-id' default correlationId, "name": attributes.headers.name, "systemId": attributes.headers.systemId, "source": attributes.headers.source }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var lisim = payload default {} var code = (lisim.CodigoRespuesta default lisim.COD_RES default lisim.code default "200") as String var message = lisim.Respuesta default lisim.RES default lisim.message default "verificacion de identidad procesada" var result = lisim.OBJ_VERIFICACION default lisim.OBJ_VALIDACION default lisim.result default lisim --- { code: code, message: message, result: result }
